title: Breaking the Waves (bc30)
synopsis: In a small and religious coastal town, a simple, devoutly religious Scottish woman, Bess McNeill, finds a partner in an oil rig worker from Norway, Jan Nyman. However, the relationship grows strained when Nyman breaks his neck in a horrific work accident on the rig and becomes paralysed. Unable to perform sexually and suffering mentally from the accident as well, Jan convinces Bess to have sex with other men, which she comes to believe is God's work. bc went on to screen many of Lars von Trier's subsequent works, establishing him as one of the most unforgettable directors among cinephiles.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 如果世上真的有無私奉獻、堅貞不渝的愛情，神又會現身為世人帶來救贖嗎？貝絲和所愛的丈夫在教堂裡許下神聖的諾言，承諾陪伴對方一生一世。可甜蜜的新婚享受不了多久，丈夫便因工作意外全身癱瘓，更表示唯有貝絲跟其他男人做愛，並與他分享細節，才能活下去。因為相信，貝絲甘願做出世人不解的行為，不介意被他人唾棄，相信丈夫會好起來。手持鏡頭飄渺恍惚的影像為電影蒙上了一種不確定感，紀錄片般的畫面引領觀眾叩問何為愛情、信仰、道德。拉斯馮特爾往後多部作品亦在 bc 公映，是影迷印象最深的導演之一。
